objectives.statement: Every recurring function runs in the cloud. The fleet operates, heals, audits, improves, publishes, and promotes itself. The human role narrows to policy-setting and exception handling.

Maximize SAI = 0.20*autonomy + 0.15*thinking + 0.15*decision + 0.15*self_improv + 0.10*reliability + 0.10*integration + 0.10*external_impact + 0.05*governance, subject to the autonomy-ladder cap, cost ceilings (A9), and the residual-consent boundary. external_impact = goals.id=50 cost-per-impact: cost_usd / (impressions + citations + subscribers + downloads), refreshed daily, scored 0..1 against the survival-gate headroom.

CORRECTED 2026-09-26 (units error fixed): AI Gateway billing is in CENTS. Actual AI Gateway spend ~$110/mo with real gateway usage ~$5.51/24h (~$165/mo), right at/under the declared $150/mo limit. Total fleet cost ~$725/mo = Cloudflare plan ~$200 + Workers AI ~$15 + AI Gateway ~$110 + direct DeepSeek/Anthropic ~$4-500. The UNMANAGED cost is the direct-provider ~$4-500/mo, which has no spend limit and no visibility. Owner directive: throttling/rate-limiting, NOT a hard cap. KPI: monthly cost_usd per source, unified.

REVISED 2026-10-01 (docs/STRATEGY.md s6.3, s8, s9): tie total spend (~$725/mo) to return measured by the reach scorecard: search impressions (GSC), engaged human sessions (GA4), social reach and engagement rate, confirmed subscribers, warm conversations, credibility events (weighted highest) and cost per engaged human. Review gate 2026-12-31: continue the research layer if (credibility_events >= 2 OR confirmed_subscribers >= 50 OR funding_secured) AND AI spend within the cap; else shrink to the selected-works core; never delete research data automatically.
